title: Black Girl Hike October
description: Join Queens Village and Touch Grass Yoga for our Black Girls Hiking Series, happening on the last Saturday of each month!
long_description:
Join Queens Village and Touch Grass Yoga for our Black Girls Hiking Series, happening on the last Saturday of each month!

About this Event

This is our last BGH of the season! Thank you for participating whether this is your first or you have been coming to all of the walks! You rock, Queen. Here's the deets for October:
🗓️ Date: Saturday, October 31st, 2026
⏰ Time: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
📍 Meeting Location: Paxton Kroger parking lot, Hyde Park (3760 Paxton Ave)
🥾 Trail Route: Walking on Wasson Way trail in Hyde Park (stroller friendly!)
📌 Important Note: We will meet up in the Kroger parking lot first before heading out together onto Wasson Way!
What to Expect: Come ready to move at your own pace along this stroller-friendly trail! During our hike, we will enjoy a peaceful stretch session led by Ambriehl, owner of Touch Grass Yoga. Wear comfortable clothes and supportive sneakers, and remember to bring a water bottle, sunglasses, sunscreen, and your great energy!
If you can no longer make it, please release your ticket as soon as possible on Eventbrite so another mama in the Village can claim the spot!

Also check out other in Cincinnati, Trips & Adventurous Activities in Cincinnati, Meetups in Cincinnati.
